comment: House (GDI/NOD) specific behavior, mainly used to hide units/super powers from certain sides.

rules.name: HideTempleFromGdi
rules.comment: Don't allow captured NOD con yards to build a NOD Temple

rules.name: HideObeliskFromGdi
rules.comment: Don't allow captured NOD con yards to build an Obelisk

rules.name: HideAdvancedCommCenterFromNod
rules.comment: Don't allow captured GDI con yards to build an Adv. Comm Center

rules.name: OnlyGdiCanUseIonCannon
rules.comment: Only allow GDI constructed Adv. Comm Center to grant the Ion Cannon superpower

rules.name: OnlyNodCanUseNuke
rules.comment: Only allow Nod constructed Temple of Nod to grant the Nuke superpower
